info.title: Akribos API
info.description:
Read-only access to the content Akribos itself is built on: bible translations, the Strong's lexicon, commentaries and search, plus a signed-in reader's own verse lists, legacy comments and unified documents. Everything lives under `/api/v1`.

## Authentication

A request from Akribos' own frontend needs nothing extra — it is recognised as same-origin. Everything else must send an API key:

```
Authorization: Bearer sk_akribos_...
```

Create a key from your [account page](/account) once signed in. Each key has a scope, chosen when it is created:

- `public` — bible text, lexicon, commentaries, search
- `personal` — the above, plus the key owner's own verse lists, comments and document working copies

## Rate limits

120 requests per minute per API key (300 requests per minute per IP for same-origin requests without a key). Exceeding it returns `429` with a `Retry-After` header, in seconds.

## Errors

Every error response has the same shape:

```json
{ "error": { "code": "unknown_bible", "message": "No bible with id 'kjv'." } }
```

## What's not here yet

This first version is read-only: creating or editing a list, adding a verse, writing a document, or publishing a note all still happen through the site itself, not through the API.

get.description:
The 66-book canon, with `id`, `name`, `shortName`, `testament` and `chapters`. `id` is what every other endpoint's `book` parameter expects.

Does not require a `personal`-scope key — any valid key, or a same-origin request, is enough.
get.x-rate-limit: 120 requests/min per API key, 300 requests/min per IP for same-origin requests.

get.summary: Available bibles, lexicons, commentaries and cross-reference sets
get.description:
Every available bible, lexicon, commentary and cross-reference set, with its `id`, `kind`, `name`, `abbrev`, `language` and license.

Does not require a `personal`-scope key.
get.x-rate-limit: 120 requests/min per API key, 300 requests/min per IP for same-origin requests.

200.description: Every public, ready-to-read resource, in display order.

get.summary: One translation's text for one chapter
get.description:
One translation's text for one chapter — `bible` is a resource id from `GET /resources`, `book` a canonical book id from `GET /books`. Returns `verses` (each with its Strong's-tagged segments) and any section `headings`.

Does not require a `personal`-scope key.
get.x-rate-limit: 120 requests/min per API key, 300 requests/min per IP for same-origin requests.

parameters.name: bible
parameters.description: A resource id from `GET /api/v1/resources` (a bible-kind resource).

parameters.name: book
parameters.description: The canonical book id from `GET /api/v1/books`.

parameters.name: chapter
parameters.description: The chapter number, 1-based.

200.description: The chapter's text in this translation.

404.description: The book id is not a valid canonical book id, the chapter number is not valid, `bible` is not a known resource id, or the resource has no text for this chapter.

error.message: "0" is not a valid chapter number.
SEEDDE has no text for this chapter.

get.description:
A Strong's number's lexicon entry (e.g. `G26`, `H430`), rendering statistics and every occurrence.

Does not require a `personal`-scope key.
get.x-rate-limit: 120 requests/min per API key, 300 requests/min per IP for same-origin requests.

parameters.name: strong
parameters.description: A Strong's number, e.g. `G26` (Greek) or `H430` (Hebrew).

parameters.name: ref
parameters.description: A verse reference (e.g. `Joh 3:16`). When it names a verse, the response's `original` and `morphology` fields carry the exact original-language form and grammar at that spot.

parameters.name: resources
parameters.description: Comma-separated resource ids. Selects which translation the rendering statistics, book counts, glosses and occurrences are computed from — the first with statistics for this number wins.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page of the occurrence list.

parameters.name: book
parameters.description: Restrict occurrences to one canonical book id.

parameters.name: gloss
parameters.description: Restrict occurrences to one translation rendering from the glosses list. Matching ignores case and surrounding whitespace; it can be combined with book.

200.description: The lexicon entry, statistics and occurrences. `found` is `false` when no lexicon covers this number — `entry` is then `null` and `alternative` suggests the same number in the other original language, if valid.

404.description: `strong` is not a syntactically valid Strong's id.

get.description:
Full-text search. `q` is required — a word, several words, or a `"quoted phrase"`, optionally with `-excluded` words.

Does not require a `personal`-scope key.
get.x-rate-limit: 120 requests/min per API key, 300 requests/min per IP for same-origin requests.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: The search term — a word, several words, a `"quoted phrase"`, or a `-excluded` word.

parameters.name: bibles
parameters.description: Comma-separated resource ids to search. Defaults to every available translation.

parameters.name: book
parameters.description: Restrict results to one canonical book id.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page of results (25 per page).

200.description: Search results, or an empty result with a spelling `suggestion` when nothing matched.

400.description: The `q` query parameter is missing or empty.

get.description: The caller's own verse lists. Requires a signed-in session or a `personal`-scope API key.
get.x-rate-limit: 120 requests/min per API key, 300 requests/min per IP for same-origin requests.

200.description: The caller's verse lists, most recently updated first.

get.summary: One verse list's items and notes
get.description: A verse list's items and notes — readable by its owner, or by anyone once its owner has turned public sharing on.
get.x-rate-limit: 120 requests/min per API key, 300 requests/min per IP for same-origin requests.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The verse list's id (UUID).

parameters.name: bible
parameters.description: Which translation's text to attach to each verse. Defaults to the first available translation.

404.description: No verse list with this id, or the list exists but is private and the caller is not its owner.

error.message: No verse list with this id.

get.summary: The caller's highlighted verses for one colour
get.description: Returns every verse the caller marked with one highlight style, optionally with text from a selected translation. Requires a signed-in session or a `personal`-scope API key.
get.x-rate-limit: 120 requests/min per API key, 300 requests/min per IP for same-origin requests.

parameters.name: style
parameters.description: One of the caller's highlight-style UUIDs. Required unless color is supplied.

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: One of the caller's palette colours, e.g. #fde68a. Used when style is omitted.

parameters.name: resource
parameters.description: Bible resource whose text is attached. Defaults to the first available Bible.

200.description: The style and every verse marked with it.

400.description: Neither style nor a known palette color was supplied.

404.description: The style does not belong to the caller, or the requested Bible is unknown.

get.summary: The caller's legacy translation and verse-list comments
get.description: The compatibility view of comments stored on one Bible translation and discussion comments the caller wrote on verse-list items. Its `{ notes: [...] }` envelope is unchanged by the unified document API. Requires a signed-in session or a `personal`-scope API key. The response is always `private, no-store`.
get.x-rate-limit: 120 requests/min per API key, 300 requests/min per IP for same-origin requests.

200.description: The caller's translation comments and verse-list-item discussion comments.

get.description: Lists only document working copies owned by the caller. Publication snapshots are separate and are never returned here. By default soft-deleted documents are omitted. Requires a signed-in session or a `personal`-scope API key. The response is always `private, no-store`.
get.x-rate-limit: 120 requests/min per API key, 300 requests/min per IP for same-origin requests.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Case-insensitive title and plain-text search.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: Restrict results to one document kind.

parameters.name: visibility
parameters.description: Restrict results to one working-copy visibility setting.

parameters.name: deleted
parameters.description: Whether to exclude soft-deleted documents (the default), return only deleted documents, or include both.

200.description: Owned document summaries, most recently updated first.

400.description: A document filter has an unsupported value.

get.description: Returns one complete owned working copy, including Markdown, sanitised HTML, nested tag paths and canonical or translation-specific passage anchors. A publication snapshot is never substituted for it. Requires a signed-in session or a `personal`-scope API key. The response is always `private, no-store`.
get.x-rate-limit: 120 requests/min per API key, 300 requests/min per IP for same-origin requests.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The document's UUID.

200.description: The complete owned document working copy.

404.description: The document does not exist, belongs to another account, or is soft-deleted.

bearerAuth.description: An API key created from the account page, sent as `Authorization: Bearer sk_akribos_...`. Not required for a same-origin request from Akribos' own frontend, which is recognised automatically.

Unauthorized.description: No API key was sent and the request is not recognised as same-origin, or the key sent is invalid or has been revoked.

error.message: This request needs an API key. See https://akribos.de/api for how to get one.
This API key is invalid or has been revoked.

PersonalScopeRequired.description: The request is authenticated, but not with a `personal`-scope key or a signed-in session.

error.message: Reading verse lists needs a signed-in session or a personal-scope API key.

RateLimited.description: More than 120 requests/min (per API key) or 300 requests/min (per IP, same-origin) were made.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the rate-limit window rolls off.

error.message: Too many requests. Try again shortly.

id.description: Canonical book id, used as the `book` parameter elsewhere in this API.

chapters.description: Number of chapters in this book.

id.description: Resource id, used as the `bible`/`resources`/`bibles` parameter elsewhere in this API.

usageNotesHtml.description: A lexicon's own "how to read this" preface, e.g. a translated dictionary's usage notes.

VerseSegment.description: One piece of a verse's structured content. A plain string is a run of unmarked text; an object carries a `kind` discriminating a Strong's-tagged word, a footnote, emphasis, a line break, or a run of Jesus's words.

oneOf.description: A word carrying a Strong's number.

text.description: The word as this translation renders it.

strong.description: Canonical Strong's id of the primary sense, e.g. `G26`.

strongs.description: All ids this word carries, including `strong`. Only present when there is more than one.

morph.description: Robinson morphology code, when the source provides one.

oneOf.description: A footnote or study note attached at this position.

marker.description: Marker shown inline, e.g. `1` or `a`. Empty means "use a generic marker".

oneOf.description: Emphasised text — italics in most sources, marking words added by the translators.
A line break inside a verse, as used in poetry.
Words of Jesus, where a source marks them.

verseEnd.description: Last verse of a merged range, when the translation prints several verses as one unit.

heading.description: Section heading printed immediately before this verse, if any.

headings.description: Headings that appear in the chapter, as `[verse, heading]` pairs keyed by the verse they precede.

licenseHtml.description: Rights notice of the lexicon this entry came from, e.g. a translated dictionary's copyright.

usageNotesHtml.description: The lexicon's own "how to read this" preface, e.g. Kautz' "Hinweise zur Benützung des Lexikons".

display.description: How the statistics resource renders this word, e.g. "lieben".

word.description: The original-language word as it appears in the source.

code.description: The morphology code as it appeared in the source, upper-cased.

partOfSpeech.description: i18n key for the part of speech, e.g. `morph.pos.verb`.

feature.description: i18n key for the feature name, e.g. `morph.feature.tense`.

value.description: i18n key for the value, e.g. `morph.tense.aorist`.

unknown.description: Code fragments that could not be interpreted.

found.description: Whether a lexicon entry exists for this number.

alternative.description: When `found` is false, the same number in the other original language, if that is a valid id.

statisticsResource.description: Which resource id the statistics, book counts, glosses and occurrences were computed from.

matchedIn.description: Which of the searched translations matched this verse.

cells.description: The verse in each requested translation, in the order requested; `null` where that translation has no text for this verse.

suggestion.description: Spelling suggestion when the search found nothing.

slug.description: Unguessable slug for the public link at `/l/{slug}`, set only while shared.

role.description: Whether the caller owns this list or was invited to collaborate on it.

ownerName.description: The owner's display name (or email), only set when `role` is `member`.

addedByUserId.description: Who added this verse; only the list's owner may remove one they did not add themselves.

segments.description: The verse text in the requested translation. `null` when that translation has no text for this verse.

UserNote.description: A legacy comment returned by the compatibility endpoint. Translation comments and verse-list discussion comments share this shape.

itemId.description: The verse-list item carrying this discussion comment when kind is `list`.

resourceId.description: The exact Bible translation when kind is `translation`.

resourceName.description: The display title of that Bible translation when kind is `translation`.

DocumentSummary.description: An owner-private mutable document working copy. Visibility is its publication setting; it does not make this working-copy response public.

plainText.description: Markup-free body text suitable for previews and client-side filtering.

visibility.description: The working copy's publication setting. Public pages still use only an explicit publication snapshot.

sourceFilename.description: The original basename for an imported Markdown file.

legacyVerseCommentId.description: The preserved source-comment id for an idempotently migrated legacy translation comment.

DocumentPassage.description: An inclusive, possibly cross-chapter or cross-book Bible range. A null resourceId is canonical; a value makes the anchor translation-specific.

tags.description: Explicit leaf tags as slash-separated nested paths.
